parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation or documented organised targeting of visitors. Tourist settings show little direct hostility, and courts have affirmed bathroom access for a trans public employee and ruled a surgery requirement unconstitutional, giving positive rule-of-law climate. Risk is mainly institutional: gender-segregated baths/spas create visitor-facing friction without a legal ban; custody/housing can follow registered rather than lived sex, with documented detention mockery, hormone-treatment delay and register-based placement; there is no enforceable anti-discrimination/violence statute and border screening is unassessed. Absence of documented attacks or service bans, functioning courts and low ordinary hostility place it above Elevated; unremedied custody/facility gaps and limited legal protection keep it below Reduced upper end. Score reflects reduced risk with notable institutional uncertainty.
